CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

2. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

13. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music

14. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
